items.name: block-finder-node-browser
items.title: Block · Finder · Node Browser
items.description: Astrale block/finder/node-browser; the Finder as a panel: Domains, Classes and a Nodes table with filters, preview, path and tray, over an injected source; each word replaceable for another language.

items.name: block-finder-node-selector
items.title: Block · Finder · Node Selector
items.description: Astrale block/finder/node-selector; the Finder in a dialog, for a host answering a request to select Nodes; the source and the answer are injected through props.

items.name: block-finder-identity-browser
items.title: Block · Finder · Identity Browser
items.description: Astrale block/finder/identity-browser; the identity finder as a panel: a search over people, groups, Roles and every other kind of Identity, each kind in its own section, groups and Roles open to their members; over an injected source, each word replaceable for another language.

items.name: block-finder-identity-selector
items.title: Block · Finder · Identity Selector
items.description: Astrale block/finder/identity-selector; the identity finder in a dialog, for a host answering a request to select people, groups or Roles; the source and the answer are injected through props.
